newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse replaces its settlement bank.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse replaces its settlement bank.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Tuesday it had appointed the central bank to replace commercial bank Bankcoop SA as its settlement bank from next week to meet the needs of custodians.
A bourse official said settement through the central bank would start on June 9 for deals struck on the exchange from this Wednesday.

"Custodians operating on the market are commercial banks and they cannot open accounts with another commercial bank, so the National Bank has been chosen to act as settlement bank for the stock exchange," a bourse official said.
Equity market regulator CNVM has so far licensed four banks and a brokerage house to operate as custodians in Romania.
The Romanian subsidiary of Dutch ABN-AMRO was the first to act as custodian on the stock exchange.
The Bucharest branch of Dutch ING Bank, France's Societe Generale and Romanian bank Banca Transilvania also won a CNVM licence to act as a custodian bank.
Creditanstalt Securities SA, which operates as broker on Romania's stock exchange and OTC market, has also launched licensed custody services.
